description: This file contains styles for the Tic Tac Toe frontend application, including global CSS variables for theme management, and styling for various components like the game board, squares, buttons, and the overall layout.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container class for the application, styling the app layout and design.

classes.name: game
classes.description: Class defining the layout for the game, including alignment and spacing for game elements.

classes.name: game-title
classes.description: Class for styling the game's title.

classes.name: game-status
classes.description: Class for displaying the current status of the game.

classes.name: game-board
classes.description: Class for styling the game board using a grid layout.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Class for individual squares on the game board, defining size and styling.

classes.name: reset-button
classes.description: Class for styling the reset button which is used to restart the game.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Class for styling the application logo with a specific size and animation.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Class for styling the header section of the application.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Class for styling links in the application.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Class for the button to toggle between light and dark themes.
